unobstructed_walking.production_decision: Current pelvis adapter retained; collision geometry candidate under evaluation
limitations: Full clean 002 horizon differs from capped 14 s LAB 002; do not compare those cohorts as a single paired experiment.
LAB 007 fall avoidance disappears without props: both clean variants complete, so it is not evidence of a flat-floor fall benefit.
003 roughness and 005 roughness/slip/XY worsen; 006 completes with little height margin; 008 still falls.
Robot FK round-trip does not validate inferred human feet or establish robust walking on Quest.

provenance.motion_collection: Pinned TWIST2 public 0807_yanjie_walk_001 through 010; full durations and normalized initial XY/yaw

physical_comparison.interpretation: The extra mass and wrist inertia are faithful official Dex hand-model content; primitive replacement did not add mass

limitations: Single-motion model controls do not identify neural policy alone as the cause.
Wrist rollback is diagnostic and is not a faithful Dex model.
This is robot-motion playback, not human foot ground truth.

guards: Simulation time failing to advance one physics timestep

numerical_validation.interpretation: Valid time/numerics are required before scoring completion or falls; the apparent tiny-finger no-fall result is excluded

confirmed_findings: Primitive fitting uses compiled mesh AABB extents, not the actual convex hull. min(cross-section extent) does not ensure an inscribed capsule.
Hip-roll capsules protrude up to33.25mm beyond source convex-hull support planes. Wrist-roll/yaw boxes have1.675x/1.635x source hull volume.
Exact HOME has true thumb-tip/hip contacts already in source meshes. Primitives amplify7.27/7.37mm source depth to27.70/25.36mm; they do not invent contact existence at this exact pose.
On frozen direct-walk008 poses, wrist_roll/wrist_yaw mesh contacts are0/0 while current primitives report200/156 frames. Thumb-tip/hip source contacts1/2 versus primitives222/232 frames.
The geometric transformation retains the compiled mesh placement; the identified error is shape over-approximation, with no evidence of a shifted primitive frame.
Existing qpos0 no-overlap unit check does not exercise actual HOME. Python Controller.initialize and native Reset use the same HOME + shoulder_roll±0.2rad.

frozen_trace.source: existing direct public walk008 physical qpos export
limitations: Fingers held at0 because the36qpos export excludes extra hand joints.
Frozen poses isolate shape differences; they are not a dynamic candidate rollout.
Gaussian independent joint perturbations around exact native/Python reset; fingers fixed0; static comparison, not walking dynamics.
True-contact recall is measured against upstream mesh, not real hardware.
Pairs absent from every model are omitted; use1024 as false-contact-rate denominator.

candidate_coverage.method: Maximum-volume principal-frame aligned inscribed shapes, greedy union coverage over deterministic Monte Carlo hull samples. Every selected shape has support-plane clearance>=1micrometre.
limitations: Coverage estimates measure volume, not surface-contact accuracy.
The bounded fitter does not prove that a better low-complexity manual compound is impossible.
Six ellipsoids per hip cover~83%; ten~87%. Six cylinders per hip~72%. More geometry adds solver contacts.
Strict3/6 compounds preserve both true HOME contacts but miss some source contacts in nearby poses; no production recommendation.

dynamic_feedback_from_parent.conclusion: A real fidelity bug is confirmed, but these primitive alternatives do not independently solve walking and show mixed execution metrics. Keep unshipped.

future_unresolved: Fit a faithful low-complexity housing/compound and validate real external manipulation contacts before deployment.
Validate or adapt the whole-body policy to the articulated hand model, rather than blind mass, gain or contact-mask changes.
